description:
Goal
Move native and dump front doors onto the same product-backed demand boundary as interp and macro readiness. Native must not wait on BackendProgram(root) by scheduling BuildBackendProduct(root), and dumps must not revive semantic/root artifact stages except where explicitly requested as legacy diagnostics.

Signal
LowerNativeProgram no longer returns follow_up [BuildBackendProduct(root)] for BackendProgram(root). Native/AOT obtains or drives RootBackendProduct through the product driver. DumpStage::Backend is product-backed. DumpStage::Semantic is either removed, renamed legacy, or documented as intentionally requesting the old semantic diagnostic path. 00181 no-dump and targeted dump telemetry do not show BuildBackendProduct self-scheduling.

Strategy
Add a shared front-door helper for driving RootBackendProduct facts/products, then route native and backend dumps through it. Keep legacy semantic dump behavior only if tests and docs name it as legacy.

Removal target
Remove BuildBackendProduct producer follow-up from native readiness. Remove stale tests that pin old visible BuildBackendProduct job shape.

Verification
Native/backend dump focused tests; macro executable test; port macro tests; 00181 --log-telemetry post-processing; cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings.
title: Pull front doors: remove native and dump push handoffs
